recap.text: Asked for a quick parachute, Mordecai offers a flight ability, a fall shield buff or turning Katia into a hang glider, but he has no seed pods for Feather Fall, which are scarce until the sixth floor. Carl, Donut and Katia each open a Silver Skydiver's Box holding three potions of Half Splat. Half Splat stops a fall from killing you but leaves you at five percent health. Carl grumbles that it still beats Dolores Doesn't Splat.

Katia counts the group seven fall-protection potions short, thanks to Eva's thievery, so Carl takes a case of twenty-four Feather Fall potions at the prize counter, one hand short of the skill upgrade he wanted. Donut points out the potions sit in a prize box. After the Sledge's five-second message, Carl shouts for potions and drinks one, distrusting his nipple ring's fall ability.

beats.headline: No seed pods
beats.text: Carl asks Mordecai what his options are if he needs a parachute quickly. One of a few dozen potions, a flight ability or a fall shield buff, says Mordecai, or turn Katia into a hang glider. He checks his stock. He does not have the Feather Fall materials: the seed pods he needs are scarce until the sixth floor, and the same goes for Bubble Boy. He has enough for one other kind of potion, maybe two of them, and Carl will not like it.
beats.gist: Mordecai lacks the seed pods for Feather Fall, so Carl's parachute options shrink to potions he won't like.

beats.headline: Not the real thing
beats.text: Carl, Donut and Katia each receive the same Silver Skydiver's Box, and each holds the same thing: three potions of Half Splat. Mordecai tells them to keep those in their hotlists until they can get a real Feather Fall. Half Splat keeps you from dying of falling damage, but you hit the ground at five percent health. Carl grumbles that they are still better than that Dolores Doesn't Splat potion.
beats.gist: Carl, Donut and Katia each get three Half Splat potions, which leave you at five percent health.

beats.headline: Twenty-four for the castle
beats.text: Katia has done a full circuit of the group and worked out that they are seven fall-protection potions short, thanks to Eva's thievery. Nobody is certain the potions will even be necessary. At the prize counter Carl wanted a skill upgrade for himself, but he is one hand short if he also refills the potion supply. So he takes a case of twenty-four Feather Fall potions, with the shrink wand, the lore book, the Skedaddle sheet music and a case of healing potions.
beats.gist: Short seven potions, Carl takes a case of twenty-four Feather Fall potions.

beats.headline: Still in a prize box
beats.text: The talent show is under way. Carl tells Donut not to wait for them: get out the moment the seal is broken, and they will try to jump on stage and follow; if that does not work, Escape Plan D. He bought Feather Fall potions, and he will hand them out. Donut points out that he does not have them: they are in a prize box, and there will be no time. Others need them, says Carl. He will hand them out as soon as Samantha turns off the inventory and magic block.
beats.gist: Carl tells Donut to escape once the seal breaks; he will hand out Feather Fall potions.

beats.headline: Five seconds, then potions
beats.text: The Recital quest completes, and the Sledge sends his last message: five seconds, good-bye. All around them is blood and carnage and death. Potions, Carl shouts. He has his nipple ring's fall ability, but he does not trust it, and drinks a Feather Fall potion. He got the potions out of their prize box, along with a bunch of other things, standing on Prepotente's personal saferoom cube, the last zap of the goat's wand, in exchange for letting Prepotente take over the party for a day or so.
beats.gist: Carl drinks a Feather Fall potion rather than trust his nipple ring's fall ability.
